normalization: Originals as fetched under original/: Internet Archive text layers (_djvu.txt) as served; Project Gutenberg plain text as served, header and licence kept; Perseus TEI as served at a pinned commit; the Text Creation Partnership's TEI as served; a Wikisource page as served with its revision id. text/<slug>.* derived by code: OCR and Gutenberg text with line endings normalized; TEI reduced to lines (the TCP's end-of-line hyphen marks removed so the word is joined, original spelling and long s kept); Wikisource parser output with navigation dropped. No text corrected by hand; the loci keep the OCR's readings (long s read as f, double spaces, broken accents).
scope: The book whole, as the Text Creation Partnership keyboarded it.
verified_loci: Hall: Sappho's choice and binding of the accidents of love — 'Thus did Sappho ſingle out all thoſe accidents that are either inherent or conſequentiall to love and melancholy'
Hall's fr. 31, its first line — 'He that ſits next thee now and hears Thy charming voyce to me appears'
Hall's fr. 31, the closing line carried over from the fifth stanza — 'I ſeem a Ghoſt. Yet ſince I'me wretched I muſt dare.'
why_seated: The first English rendering of fr. 31, inside Longinus's chapter 10, in four stanzas, and the fifth stanza's opening carried over as a closing line: 'Yet ſince I'me wretched I muſt dare.' (Closing the Fragment v7 §6.)
ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-11-07: "i think we need a sappho reception history ea-corpora, whatever's public. translators, scholars. theres some ground work in the archive, notes towards a future reader i believe. the seating can include everything thats publicly available as well as declared absences and pointers for material behind pay- and access- and rights-walls"; and: "sappho reception history + future reader frameworks and related".
seating: EA-CORPORA-36, the thirty-sixth seating: Sappho's reception and the future reader, 1652–1993, 2026-11-07
research: The revision of Closing the Fragment (v7, a draft of 2026-11-07 for Alexanarch), whose §6 controls the January composition against the translators from Hall (1652) to Carson and whose §8 declares an exposure-checked panel; and the Sappho Future Reader framework, whose groundwork is Research Notes Towards the Future Reader (#1548: Part I the scholarly field, Part II the future reader in twelve strata), and whose reading by a signed-out ChatGPT on 2026-11-07 is seated as capture 0C3D (sappho-future-reader-framework-constitutive-materials-chatgpt-20261107).
